people.name: Nasser Khalili
people.title: Scientia Professor; Head of School
people.researchFocus: Mechanics of granular and multiphase porous media, computational geomechanics and unsaturated soil mechanics, applied to foundations, dams and energy geostructures. Directs the ARC Research Hub for Resilient and Intelligent Infrastructure Systems.

people.name: Adrian Russell
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: How infrastructure such as tailings storages, foundations, tunnels and railways interacts with the ground, through constitutive and physical modelling. Translates unsaturated soil mechanics into design tools for mining and slope stability.

people.name: Kurt Douglas
people.title: Associate Professor (Pells Sullivan Meynink Associate Professor of Rock Mechanics)
people.researchFocus: Rock mass strength and deformation prediction for the design of foundations, tunnels, slopes and dams, plus spillway erosion and piping behaviour in embankment dams.

people.name: Arman Khoshghalb
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Numerical and computational techniques for coupled hydro-mechanical problems in unsaturated and elasto-plastic porous media, including bio-cemented soil-steel interfaces and coupled hydro-thermal response of unsaturated soils.

people.name: Taha Hossein Rashidi
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Travel behaviour, activity-based travel demand modelling and integrated land-use/transport models, including how new mobility technologies and social media data reshape city planning. Member of rCITI.

people.name: Wengui Li
people.title: Scientia Associate Professor (ARC Future Fellow)
people.researchFocus: Leads the Intelligent Concrete and Infrastructure Materials group, developing multifunctional concrete with self-sensing, self-healing and energy harvesting or storage capabilities using nanomaterials.

people.name: Kefeng Zhang
people.title: Senior Lecturer (Water Research Centre)
people.researchFocus: Stormwater management and nature-based solutions such as bioretention systems, wetlands and green walls for urban water treatment, plus pollutant and health risk assessment in stormwater harvesting and water recycling.

people.name: Fiona Johnson
people.title: Scientia Associate Professor; Director, Water Research Centre
people.researchFocus: Hydroclimatology, climate change impact assessment and water resources planning, developing methods that let industry and governments plan water infrastructure under uncertainty.

people.name: David Airey
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Soil mechanics and the pre-failure behaviour of geomaterials, with long-standing interests in granular mechanics and marine geoscience. Active in international geotechnical testing committees.

people.name: Itai Einav
people.title: Professor of Geomechanics
people.researchFocus: Founded Breakage Mechanics theory and heterarchical granular dynamics, and pioneered X-ray rheography for granular systems. Directs the Sydney Centre in Geomechanics and Mining Materials.

people.name: Abbas El-Zein
people.title: Professor of Environmental Engineering
people.researchFocus: Leads the Geoenvironmental Engineering Research Group, studying soil hydrology, groundwater contamination, flooding and sea-level rise, and advises governments on water resources and environmental sustainability.

people.name: David Levinson
people.title: Professor of Transport Engineering
people.researchFocus: Leads TransportLab, researching transport networks, accessibility, travel behaviour and road pricing. Founding editor of the Journal of Transport and Land Use and of Findings.

people.name: Luming Shen
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Computational mechanics and multiscale modelling of structural materials under extreme loading. Previously Associate Head for Research in the School of Civil Engineering.

people.name: Daniel Dias-da-Costa
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Structural engineering meets AI: computer vision and large language models for crack detection, post-disaster damage assessment and construction safety, plus machine-learning frameworks for low-carbon concrete design.

people.name: Ali Amin
people.title: Associate Professor (ARC Industry Fellow); Associate Head (Research)
people.researchFocus: Structural analysis and design of high-performance and fibre-reinforced concrete structures, contributing to Australian standard provisions for steel fibre reinforced concrete.

people.name: Ali Hadigheh
people.title: Associate Professor; Associate Head of School (Research Education)
people.researchFocus: Leads the Smart Materials and Sustainable Structures group, designing multifunctional circular materials from composite wastes and industrial by-products, plus structural health monitoring and additive manufacturing.

people.name: Andres Fielbaum
people.title: Senior Lecturer (ARC DECRA Senior Research Fellow)
people.researchFocus: Public transport network design, optimisation and operations within the Transport Engineering group, applying mathematical and systems engineering to transit systems.

people.name: Behzad Fatahi
people.title: Professor; Head of School, Civil, Environmental & Sociotechnical Engineering
people.researchFocus: Soil-structure interaction, dynamic behaviour of soils and railway geotechnics, including ground improvement, unsaturated soil mechanics and earthquake engineering for roads, railways, pipelines and energy-storage facilities.

people.name: Hadi Khabbaz
people.title: Professor; Head of Discipline (Geotechnical and Transport Engineering)
people.researchFocus: Unsaturated soil mechanics and geo-environmental engineering, focusing on theoretical and numerical analysis of soft soils, granular particles and unsaturated porous media, and ground improvement of problematic soils.

people.name: Sanjay Nimbalkar
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Safety, stability and sustainability of road pavements and railway tracks through constitutive and numerical modelling plus field monitoring, with work on geosynthetics and pseudo-dynamic analysis of retaining structures.

people.name: Jianchun Li
people.title: Professor of Structural Dynamics
people.researchFocus: Co-Director of the Centre for Built Infrastructure Research: structural health monitoring, smart materials, vibration control and seismic protection, including physics-informed neural operators and digital twins for bridges and pipelines.

people.name: Mark Stewart
people.title: Distinguished Professor; Director, Centre for Built Infrastructure Resilience
people.researchFocus: Probabilistic risk and reliability assessment of infrastructure subject to natural and man-made hazards, including climate change adaptation engineering. Editor-in-Chief of Structural Safety.

people.name: Arnaud Castel
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Low-carbon concrete and sustainable construction, including geopolymer and blended-cement concretes, service-life design and durability of reinforced and prestressed structures.

people.name: Vute Sirivivatnanon
people.title: Professor of Structural and Materials Engineering
people.researchFocus: Advanced concrete technology, particularly durability, limit-states service-life design and the use of industrial by-products in concrete.

people.name: Ho Kyong Shon
people.title: Professor; Head of Discipline, Environmental & Water Engineering
people.researchFocus: Membrane technologies, desalination, water reuse, resource recovery and environmental nanomaterials. Directs the ARC Research Hub for Nutrients in a Circular Economy and is Editor-in-Chief of Desalination.

people.name: Ali Altaee
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Alternative water sources, particularly reverse osmosis and membrane processes, osmotic-energy water purification and low-energy seawater treatment, with water quality and environmental impact assessment.

people.name: Anna Giacomini
people.title: Professor; Head of Discipline, Civil and Environmental Engineering and Surveying
people.researchFocus: Geotechnical and rock mechanics engineering focused on rockfall hazard, slope stability and protecting infrastructure from rock impact.

people.name: Olivier Buzzi
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Soil mechanics and geotechnical engineering, including unsaturated soils, soil-structure interaction and ground improvement for transport and energy infrastructure.

people.name: Shanyong Wang
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Geotechnical engineering and geomechanics, with work on soil nailing, slope reinforcement, tunnelling and numerical modelling of ground behaviour.

people.name: Jinsong Huang
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Computational geomechanics and probabilistic slope stability, applying advanced numerical and reliability methods to soil and rock problems.

people.name: Klaus Thoeni
people.title: Associate Professor; Associate Dean Research (Industry Engagement)
people.researchFocus: Computational modelling at the interface of geotechnical and structural engineering, notably discrete element modelling of rockfill, rockfall and granular systems.

people.name: Jubert Pineda
people.title: Dr; Director of HDR Students
people.researchFocus: Experimental soil mechanics, particularly cyclic and liquefaction behaviour of sands and tailings and its implications for foundation and dam design.

people.name: Mark Masia
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Masonry and concrete structures, including in-plane and out-of-plane behaviour of unreinforced masonry walls and seismic assessment of existing buildings.

people.name: Ryan Hoult
people.title: Senior Lecturer
people.researchFocus: Reinforced concrete and precast seismic-resistant structural systems, plus structural health monitoring and assessment of existing infrastructure.

people.name: Gregory Hancock
people.title: Associate Professor - Research
people.researchFocus: Steel and thin-walled members, cold-formed steel structures and structural stability.

people.name: Mehdi Khaki
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Hydrology and water resources, using satellite remote sensing and data assimilation to track groundwater, soil moisture and terrestrial water storage.

people.name: Anthony Kiem
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Hydroclimatology and water resource risk, examining climate variability such as ENSO and the IPO and its implications for Australian water allocation and drought planning.

people.name: Neaz Sheikh
people.title: Professor; Associate Head of School (Civil, Mining, Environmental, Architectural)
people.researchFocus: Reinforced concrete and fibre-reinforced polymer reinforcement, concrete-filled steel tubes and the behaviour of composite structural members.

people.name: Alexander Remennikov
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Structural response to blast and impact loading, and protective design of buildings against explosive and vehicle-borne threats.

people.name: Jayan S. Vinod
people.title: Associate Professor; Deputy Head of Postgraduate Studies
people.researchFocus: Unsaturated soils, ground improvement, and the stability of mine spoil and tailings materials.

people.name: Shuqing Yang
people.title: Associate Professor
people.researchFocus: Environmental hydraulics, hydraulic modelling of open-channel and coastal-zone flows, and mixing and transport processes in water bodies.

people.name: Muttucumaru Sivakumar
people.title: Professor; Academic Program Director (Environmental Engineering)
people.researchFocus: Water and wastewater treatment, water quality and low-cost treatment processes for urban and industrial water systems.

people.name: Guangming Jiang
people.title: Professor
people.researchFocus: Environmental biotechnology and water engineering, covering sewer corrosion and odour control, biofilms and microbial processes in water systems.
